status: project robustness protocol, not paper-reported PRTI-GH results
seed_protocol: The configured seeds form a deterministic project robustness set. Wei et al. do not specify this PRTI-GH multi-seed protocol.
selection_boundary: The study measures stochastic stability. It does not automatically approve a configuration or patient-level release.

configurations.selection_basis: The existing labelled baseline used k=10, 30 clusters, and lambda=1.

configurations.purpose: Lowest seed-9 measured linkage and homogeneity exposure
configurations.selection_basis: The completed seed-9 one-factor study observed zero linkage and homogeneity records at k=10, 4 clusters, and lambda=1.
The completed seed-9 one-factor study observed its lowest information loss at k=10, 30 clusters, and lambda=0.001.
The completed seed-9 one-factor study placed the 10-cluster setting between the 4- and 30-cluster settings in information loss and sensitive-attribute diversity.
